newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MISSING KAREMBEU RETURNS TO SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MISSING KAREMBEU RETURNS TO SAMPDORIA.

text.p: International midfielder Christian Karembeu, who failed to return to his Italian club Sampdoria on time after playing for France against Portugal on Wednesday, showed up in Italy late on Friday.
Karembeu declined to say why he was back late, telling reporters: "I'll talk about it tomorrow with the coach."
Sampdoria coach Sven Goran Eriksson was earlier reported to be furious with the player for missing Friday's training session.
"When he comes back, I will give him a cellular phone. I do not think he will be playing on Sunday," Eriksson was quoted as saying.
